description: Sample debt portfolio — 5 synthetic debts representing a common multi-card situation. All values are illustrative and do not represent any real account. APRs are near July 2026 national averages cited by the Federal Reserve (22.15% average for balances) and LendingTree (23.79% average for new offers).

notes.avalancheOrder: Target RedCard → Chase Sapphire → Capital One Quicksilver → Discover it → Personal Loan
notes.snowballOrder: Target RedCard → Discover it → Capital One Quicksilver → Chase Sapphire → Personal Loan
notes.dataSource: Synthetic. APRs chosen near July 2026 national averages: Federal Reserve reported 22.15% average APR on balances (May 2026); LendingTree reported 23.79% on new offers (July 2026); WalletHub reported 22.21% on new offers (July 2026). Store card APR (28.99%) reflects typical retail credit card range. Personal loan APR (12.75%) reflects a typical unsecured personal loan for good-credit borrowers.
